prompt: A café where you take orders: bring each customer the drink they asked for before closing time

intent.setting: a neighbourhood café with a counter, customer seating and a back kitchen
intent.goal: bring each customer the drink they asked for before closing time
intent.fail: a customer leaves unserved or the café closes with orders still open
intent.headline: Each customer's ordered drink must reach the right table before the closing bell.

headline.text: Each customer's ordered drink must reach the right table before the closing bell.
headline.method: static goal regression over rules + physics, 12 AI runners

chips.text: win ← r_win (team:red reaches 2) ← r_serve_1 (cup_1 into table_1_drink, carried by red) ← pick up cup_1 + r_serve_2 (cup_2 into table_2_drink, carried by red) ← pick up cup_2
Table two can be reached with the tray
